newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bayer aims to boost Thailand market share.
newsitem.headline: Bayer aims to boost Thailand market share.

text.p: The Thai subsidiary of German chemical giant Bayer AG will launch a major drive to increase its share of the Thai pharmaceuticals market, senior executives said on Wednesday.

Axel Foellmer, managing director of Bayer Thai Co Ltd, said the company would sign up with a new product distributor, and undergo some internal restructuring, to boost its presence in Thailand's over the counter (OTC) medicines market.

"In Thailand our pharmaceuticals at present are certainly under-represented compared to the strong position Bayer has in the world market. The OTC business is more or less non-existant at present," he told Reuters in an interview.
Industry sources said Bayer, which produces household names such as Alka Seltzer, was set to bring a new distributor after dropping previous partner Zuellig FE Bangkok, a subsidiary of Zuellig.
A formal deal was expected to be announced later this month, they said.
"I think we need a strong local distributor, and we need strong marketing and a commitment to invest in the market," Foellmer said.
Thailand's over the counter medicines market is estimated to be worth around $500 million a year.
